tagline: Leading owner and operator of high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: As a REIT specializing in grocery-anchored open-air shopping centers, portfolio occupancy rate is the key KPI reflecting the company's operational health and leasing performance, directly tied to revenue generation and cash flow stability.

kpis.name: Portfolio Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leasable space occupied across the Company's property portfolio.
kpis.description: Measures the effectiveness of real estate asset management and leasing demand.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational health and leasing performance.

kpis.name: Net Lease Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from rental leases after deduction of direct operating expenses.
kpis.description: Reflects the performance of real estate leasing activities, a core component of REITs.
kpis.signal: Primary source of stable and predictable revenue.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain, redevelop, or expand the company's real estate assets.
kpis.description: Demonstrates the Company's commitment to improving and expanding its properties.
kpis.signal: Strategic investments in the real estate portfolio.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Indicates workforce size and reflects the company's operational structure.
kpis.signal: Stable workforce of approximately 710 employees as of December 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Average Employee Tenure
kpis.explanation: Average number of years employees have worked for the company.
kpis.description: Reflects management team stability and talent retention.
kpis.signal: Personnel stability and continuity with an average tenure of over 10 years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €19.69 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €8.31 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.21 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $2.14 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.585 billion in the latest year.

risks.title: Major Tenant Default Risks
risks.score_rationale: The inability of major tenants to pay rent due to bankruptcy, insolvency, or economic difficulties could significantly reduce the Company's revenues.

risks.title: E-commerce and Changing Consumer Behavior Risks
risks.score_rationale: The impact of e-commerce and evolving retail shopping patterns could reduce demand for physical retail space.

risks.title: Financing and Capital Markets Access Risks
risks.score_rationale: Inability to access capital markets or refinance debt on favorable terms could impair investment capacity and growth.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in interest rates affect financing costs and the valuation of the Company's assets.

risks.title: Climate and Extreme Weather Event Risks
risks.score_rationale: Physical climate risks, including storms, floods, and wildfires, could damage properties and increase operating and insurance costs.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in government laws, particularly regarding data privacy, environment, and health, could affect operations and increase costs.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Information Security Risks
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks, data breaches, or other security incidents could disrupt operations and cause reputational damage.

risks.title: UPREIT Structure and REIT Status Risks
risks.score_rationale: Failure to maintain REIT status or risks associated with the UPREIT structure could result in adverse tax implications.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Corporate responsibility issues, including environmental and social concerns, could affect reputation and investor appeal.

ai_positioning.summary: Kimco Realty has mentioned risks related to artificial intelligence in its forward-looking risk factors, but has not developed a specific strategic positioning around AI. As a real estate company, AI is not a core element of its value proposition.
